note: `referencePng` is exported by the Devup Bridge plugin when one serves the file, so a reference image no longer needs login or spends Figma allowance: `get_screenshot` draws the node alone - no layer beside, above or below it - over the fills of the frames and sections it sits in and the page background, across the node's render bounds, so the plugin exports the node alone over the same bounds (`contentsOnly: true`, `useAbsoluteBounds: false`; scale 1 with the longer edge held to 8192px like the direct path's `maxDimension`, sRGB), names the colour its ancestors make under it, and the bridge flattens the export onto that colour and hands it back as the single image block `get_screenshot` gives, through the same validation. That is the same picture only while the ancestors make one colour; when an ancestor is painted with an image or a gradient, blends, is translucent, or reaches the node with a stroke, a rounded corner, an inner effect or a mask, the plugin refuses with `DEVUP_REFERENCE_PNG_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE` and the reason, and the read goes to `get_screenshot` or the export stops with what to do. Measured against `get_screenshot` on fourteen nodes: the twelve the plugin drew had the same sizes and differed by at most 16/255 (37/255 on a photo grid), the render harness scored each screen within 0.02 points either way, and the two it refused came back from `get_screenshot` byte for byte. The plugin manifest declares `enablePrivatePluginApi`, which Figma requires before it fills `figma.fileKey`; builds without it reported no key. A plugin built before this devup-mcp answers `DEVUP_BRIDGE_UNKNOWN_SCRIPT`; that read, and a reference PNG over the 8 MiB one bridge answer carries (`DEVUP_REFERENCE_PNG_TOO_LARGE`, now `DEVUP_FIGMA_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE`), go to the direct path when the plugin reported the file's key, and when the direct path refuses with nothing to retry (no login) the plugin's refusal comes back with what to do instead of a login prompt. An asset too large to send says how large it was. `devup_figma_auth` lists `referencePng` among what needs login only when the plugin refuses it as `DEVUP_REFERENCE_PNG_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE`. Update the plugin checkout and run the plugin again to get the new reads.
